t: You're looking at the garden gates and railings along the road frontage of St Pancras Old Church, in Camden. The churchyard behind them is where the Chevalier d'Éon is buried. D'Éon was a French diplomat, spy and soldier, born in 1728, who lived openly as a trans woman while in exile in England. D'Éon died in 1810, and the grave is within these grounds.
